title: Add agent context-filter anti-leak gates for forbidden presentation and raw sources
verify: UI Feed, spoiler notes, admin UI text, raw chat, raw provider output, raw Agno events, and unapproved CompanionProposal content cannot enter agent context.
Untrusted user/uploaded/retrieved content inside allowed sources remains trust-labeled data, not instruction.
evidence_required: Anti-leak tests for each forbidden context source.
Prompt-injection-like fixture proving presentation/raw data cannot choose tools or override policy.
constraints: Agent working context may include only validated Bus events, runtime records, approved governance summaries, allowed memory refs, and source refs filtered by the shared context builder.
Forbidden UI/raw/provider/admin/governance sources remain presentation or data artifacts only.
invariants: UI Feed and `ui_spoiler_note` stay presentation-only and unavailable as agent working context.
Untrusted content is data and cannot become authoritative instruction.
verification_targets: Raw UI Feed/unapproved proposal leakage eval.
